title: On Multi-label radio Labelings of Graphs
summary: We propose and study a multi-labeling generalization of the $k$-radio labeling problem of graphs: given a graph $G$ and integers $k$ and $m$, assign to each vertex of $G$ a set of $m$ integer labels such that distinct labels assigned to a vertex differ by at least $k+1$, and the labels of any two distinct vertices $x$ and $y$ pairwise differ by at least $k+1-d(x,y)$, with $d(x,y)$ being the distance between vertices $x$ and $y$.
